evidenceClasses.browser: Desktop Chromium with mobile viewport and touch emulation; not a real phone
evidenceClasses.permission: Browser-controlled denial; not an OS permission test
evidenceClasses.code: Read-only navigation, manifest, and service-worker inspection

codeReview.position: watchPosition with high accuracy; actual latitude, longitude and accuracy unavailable without a device
headingPriority: derived movement only when native speed is absent and movement is qualified
device orientation fallback if heading remains absent
speedPriority: derived movement if native speed absent and movement is qualified
codeReview.nullSpeedAndHeading: HUD displays -- when unavailable; no fabricated numeric reading
codeReview.derivedMovementGuard: Both accuracies <= 50 m and elapsed 1-30 seconds; heading requires at least 5 m movement
codeReview.gpsWatcher: clearWatch on stop, retry and component unmount; duplicate-watch behavior on real background/foreground not tested
codeReview.orientation: Explicit compass button requests iOS permission where supported and installs orientation listeners; real sensor behavior not tested
codeReview.track: User-started points saved in device localStorage; pause/resume/stop and 10 s or 10 m append rule exist in code
codeReview.eta: Straight-line distance divided by speed; null below 0.5 knots
codeReview.serverLocationWrite: No navigation coordinate/track write found in inspected component or storage adapter; device and network verification still required
codeReview.navigationWarning: Straight-line aid; no safe-route, land, reef, or depth avoidance inference

P1.finding: No smartphone was available or connected; device and installed-PWA requirements cannot be assessed.

INFO: Desktop mobile viewport and source review are supporting evidence only
Optional marine-source 503 responses are existing availability limits, not a GPS/PWA finding
